title: 4-line-to-10-line decoder (1-of-10)

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)
sources.familyUsed: SN7442A (the 1976 book lists only the A version of the plain 74 part)

functions.formula: 0 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A')
functions.text: Output 0 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 1 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A)
functions.text: Output 1 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 2 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A')
functions.text: Output 2 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0010; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 3 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A)
functions.text: Output 3 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0011; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 4 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A')
functions.text: Output 4 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0100; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 5 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A)
functions.text: Output 5 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0101; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 6 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A')
functions.text: Output 6 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0110; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 7 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A)
functions.text: Output 7 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0111; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 8 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A')
functions.text: Output 8 is low (active) only when DCBA = 1000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

functions.formula: 9 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A)
functions.text: Output 9 is low (active) only when DCBA = 1001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 2 levels of logic
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 3 levels of logic
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 2 levels of logic
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 3 levels of logic

electrical.notes: The SN7442A column of the recommended operating conditions prints IOH as '800' uA without the minus sign; the SN5442A column and the VOH test condition (IOH = -800 uA) show it is -800 uA out of the pin.

notes: Datasheet does not say which output paths go through 2 and which through 3 levels of logic; timing gives both rows for all outputs. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
